local_change: Keep the original adapter's selected composite rule and accuracy floor. For each candidate target compute the best empirical accuracy among constants, all other individual variables and their negations on the same training states. Suppress only if composite accuracy minus that best simple accuracy reaches the selected strictly positive margin. No new formula, core, memory or acquisition rule. Exact copies and inverses have best simple accuracy one and cannot pass.
development_selection: At both budgets: clean OR and identity physical BA loss versus original memory <=0.005; noise10 physical BA loss versus original <=0.005, direct BA loss versus calibrated memory <=0.01, and readout FPR increase versus calibrated memory <=0.02. Among passing margins maximize mean direct BA at budget4 across all six conditions minus noise10 FPR at budget8. Tie in grid order. If none passes choose smallest summed excess over these guards then largest objective; explicitly mark failure. Independently choose the tree filter among original, calibrated and all three increments using its own same objective, without extra restrictions.
confirmation_criteria: Apply the same retention guards without retuning. Require positive noise10 budget4 direct-BA difference versus both the shared-filter and independently selected tree. Report paired 95% intervals, ties and losses separately. Report noise10 and noise20 FPR differences without presuming strict improvement when both filters reach zero. Exact-copy success means no physical loss or suppression; it does not mean resolving causal orientation.
fairness: All methods share identical raw before/after records, observed contexts, announced rounds, retained history, candidate variables and interaction budgets. The shared-filter tree and next-state tree receive the exact same suppression mask as guarded memory. A tree independently selects its filter on development only. No truth, condition name, seed or known noise rate is given to the filter or learner.
scope: Finite observed-context component composition using the unchanged previous generator, six conditions, four rounds and supplied changed-cell acquisition. Budget4 and budget8 mean 60 and120 total interventions. The increment is empirical predictive evidence, not a causal direction or statistical coverage guarantee. Preserve previous results and manuscript files.
statistics: Average four rounds within each independent seed. Paired family bootstrap with10000 resamples and fixed seed117419. All conditions and methods retained. Confirmation seed set and stopping point fixed before observing confirmation data. Scope comparisons are descriptive.
